oscillator.pinout_source: CX317 manufacturer datasheet p. 2; pin 4 Vc and direct assembled-rig rail measurement

power_path.description: USB-C breakout to Adafruit TPS62827 3.3 V buck, then stated 120 ohm ferrite bead to the common-ground CX317/SN74LVC1G17 rail
power_path.dirty_supply_source: USB-C source through the documented breakout; source identity and input margin unavailable
power_path.clean_supply_node: shared CX317 and SN74LVC1G17 rail after the installed power path
power_path.filtering: operator-stated 120 ohm ferrite bead; exact part, DCR and ripple response unavailable

conditioning.oscillator_output_conditioner: SN74LVC1G17 from CX317 output into the accepted PPS-gated cumulative-snapshot observation path

control_path.network: AD5693R output through the unchanged passive series network to CX317 pin 4 Vc on a common ground
control_path.voltage_model: Nominal AD5693R internal-reference/gain-1 transfer 2.5 V/65536 codes only. Manufacturer TUE plus the unchanged passive topology supplied the pre-command safety envelope; no fresh connected low/centre/high voltage calibration is claimed.

uncertainty.method: Stage 5 six drift-cancelled same-code brackets observed 0.00016357422282453626 to 0.00017334010044578463 Hz/code; finite-run characterization only, with calibrated and combined uncertainty unavailable

valid_neighborhood.basis: Exact Stage 5 bidirectional A950,A850,A800,A850,A950,AA50,AB00,AA50,A950 campaign; 2400 s dwells, 900 s exclusion and selected 600 s estimator

settling_evidence.method: The 900 s exclusion plus fresh 600 s selected-estimator support produced at least two outputs per dwell and maximum within-dwell range 0.0016666669398546219 Hz, below the sealed same-backend Stage 3 empirical floor 0.0033333317438761396 Hz. No sub-resolution t95 is claimed.

crossing_estimate.method: Nominal 43069.627035 codes from the Stage 5 drift-adjusted bracket and median gain. Observe-only replay envelope adds full conservative components: Stage 3 empirical floor/minimum measured gain 20.3781 codes, maximum observed interior hysteresis 7.3493 codes, and centre raw visit span/minimum measured gain 10.1890 codes; total 37.9164 codes rounded outward to 38.
crossing_estimate.uncertainty_scope: Conservative finite-run replay envelope only; not calibrated, traceable, statistical coverage or actuation authority

temperature_policy.basis: The original range was explicitly observational context. A fresh nine-code interleaved run at 30.362..30.851 C remained monotonic with fitted gain 0.0001699582 Hz/code, R2 0.9970, and no detectable temperature contribution after code/time terms.

limitations: Applicability is code-domain and observe-only; fresh connected low/centre/high Vc measurements and calibrated voltage uncertainty are unavailable.

The combined 27.259 to 30.851 C SHT41 range is nearby-air context, not a demonstrated CX317 temperature sensitivity or internal/case-temperature applicability bound. Missing, stale or out-of-context SHT41 data remains labelled telemetry and does not invalidate an otherwise healthy frequency observation or code-domain plant model.

The rapid nine-code interleaved run used 60/120 s diagnostic estimates after 600 s exclusion. It confirms monotonic gain and tests temperature context but does not supersede the selected 600 s estimator or calibrated-uncertainty limitations.
A 900 s exclusion passed only at the selected 600 s estimator resolution; t95 and a controller cadence remain unavailable.
Interior bidirectional hysteresis was 7.3493 and 2.4500 equivalent codes; endpoint bidirectional hysteresis and population bounds are unavailable.
Counter-aperture, GPS reference, calibration and combined uncertainty remain unavailable; no calibrated absolute accuracy or isolated firmware-jitter claim is made.
D8 duty, rise/fall, physical phase/duty margin, supply ripple/transient and installed ferrite identity remain untested or unavailable.
D10 is a general auxiliary edge input; same-PPS agreement applies only when the run manifest declares that connection.
The model is invalid for holdover, thermal compensation, phase discipline, adaptive control or active steering.

invalidation_conditions: Any change to CX317, AD5693R address/reference/gain, DAC-to-Vc network, shared power path, SN74LVC1G17 conditioner, D8/GPIO20 connection, PPS source path or RP2040 board.
Any measurement backend other than OTIS_TCXO_COUNTER_BACKEND_PPS_GATED_RATIO or snapshot backend other than pio_wait_cumulative_snapshot_dma_v1.
Any estimator contract/hash/span other than PPS_CUMULATIVE_SNAPSHOT_SPAN_V1 with the bound 600 s non-overlapping authority policy.
Any code outside 0xA800..0xAB00. SHT41 temperature is a labelled nearby-air covariate and is not a code-domain model invalidation condition.

Any span crossing a DAC epoch, settling exclusion, invalid interval, session boundary, sequence discontinuity, reference-association failure, snapshot/counter/FIFO/DMA/ring fault, parser/transport loss or reset evidence.
Any use before 900 s exclusion plus 600 s fresh contiguous estimator history after a DAC change.
Any same-PPS run declaring D10 comparison that observes D14/D10 disagreement; another D10 source requires its own declared health policy.
Any use of the nominal AD5693R transfer as a fresh connected-voltage measurement or calibrated voltage model.
Any use for active steering while status.control_ready or status.actuation_enabled is false.
